text:
Maya: Quick heads-up — Friday 10:00am PT we'll run a compact all-hands (~35m): product launch callouts + an important data retention policy update. Recording and slide deck will be posted afterward. Please drop any questions below so we can slot them into the Q&A. Agenda: 1) Launch status & rollout plan (10m) 2) Data retention & compliance changes (10m) 3) Support & Dedicated runway (5m) 4) Open Q&A (10m)

Omar: Will Dedicated customers see any changes to their default log retention?

Maya: Good Q — no forced change to Dedicated defaults. We're proposing a new shorter default for hosted accounts, with opt-in longer retention for enterprise/Dedicated. We'll cover specifics Friday.

Sasha: For Private (VPC/on-prem), does this impact local audit logs at all?

Maya: Short answer: no. Private deployments remain customer-managed. The policy change is for Redwood-hosted storage only.

Liam: Can we get the slides beforehand? Need to prep notes for customer calls.

Nora: We'll try to share the deck 30m before the meeting; if not, it'll be posted immediately after.

Liam: Thanks — that helps.

Maya: Also FYI: we'll call out a small rollout tweak for the new streaming endpoint (retries/timeout defaults). Nothing breaking, just opt-in for early customers; ops will announce exact flags in the release notes.

Sasha: Putting a couple Qs here for the Q&A: 1) Are backup/restore SLAs affected? 2) Will retention UI appear in Console or API only?

Maya: Good ones — we'll answer both. Short answers: SLA unchanged, Console + API both planned.

deploy-bot: NOTE: Friday maintenance window scheduled 09:00-09:30 PT (non-disruptive). See <https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/337|incident-337>

Omar: Heads-up for PMs — I'll paste a short blurb you can use in customer comms after the call.

-- (meeting happened) --

Maya: Recording uploaded: https://internal.redwood.ai/recordings/2025-05-09-allhands-ops-product.mp4 :white_check_mark:

Nora: Slide deck & TL;DR here: https://internal.redwood.ai/slides/2025-05-09-allhands-deck.pdf

Nora: TL;DR takeaways: • Hosted accounts: default retention shortened from 90d -> 30d, opt-in to 90d for paid tiers • Dedicated: no default change; admins can set retention per pool • Private: unaffected (customer-managed) • Streaming endpoint: opt-in timeout/retry flags rolling out next week • Support: playbook updated, outreach to top 50 customers starting Monday

Maya: Thanks everyone for the quick turn. If you added Qs and we didn't answer them live, ping me or drop them here and we'll follow up individually.

Omar: Copy — will share comms draft by EOD for review.

Sasha: Appreciate the clarity.

Liam: Saved the recording + deck. Link to comms draft when ready pls.

Nora: I'll post the customer comms draft in #sales and #customer-success once Omar posts it.

Maya: Closing notes: no immediate action required from eng teams unless you get an email from support. Thanks team — good sync.
